project_context.core_goal: Full visual overhaul maintaining existing functionality, tightly packed single-column flow, NO large empty scroll gaps. Emulate Devang Singh's poster style.

typography.instructions: Import Google Fonts Anton and Manrope. Use Anton for all headlines (H1, H2, H3), tags, and film slate labels in UPPERCASE. Use Manrope for body text, descriptions, and functional UI.

hierarchy.H1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl font-['Anton'] uppercase tracking-wider leading-none
hierarchy.H2: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-['Anton'] uppercase tracking-wide leading-tight

film_strip_borders.description: Vertical film-strip sprocket holes running down the left/right edges of the main container.
film_strip_borders.implementation: Create a wrapper component `FilmStripWrapper` that adds left and right columns (w-6 to w-8) with a repeating linear or radial gradient to mimic sprocket holes, or use a custom SVG background. For example: a dark column with repeating transparent rounded rectangles (using mask-image or radial gradients).

clapperboard_stripes.description: Diagonal striped pattern for the top bar of cards.
clapperboard_stripes.usage: Use as a top border element (h-4 or h-6) on 'Services' cards and the 'Info Slate'.

marker_underlines.description: Hand-drawn highlighter/marker strokes behind key words.
marker_underlines.implementation: Wrap the highlighted word in a `<span className="relative inline-block">`. Add an SVG path or a `::after` pseudo-element with `bg-[#F5B841] -z-10 rounded-sm transform -rotate-1` underneath the text.

tags_and_stickers.description: Rotated black or gold rounded rectangles used for stats, tags, or small labels.
tags_and_stickers.css_classes: inline-block bg-[#050505] text-[#F5B841] font-['Anton'] px-3 py-1 rounded-sm transform rotate-[-2deg] uppercase text-sm tracking-wider shadow-md border border-[#F5B841]/20

corner_brackets.description: Small L-shaped brackets in the corners of sections/images.
corner_brackets.implementation: Absolute positioned divs in corners. Top-left: `border-l-2 border-t-2`, Bottom-right: `border-r-2 border-b-2` etc.

film_slate_label.structure: Absolute positioned at top-left/right of sections. `text-xs tracking-[0.2em] uppercase border border-[#F5B841]/30 px-2 py-1 bg-[#050505] text-[#F5B841]`.

info_slate_card.description: Central slate card used in Hero (Location/Setup/Crew/Delivery).
info_slate_card.structure: Black background card, white/gold text, clapperboard striped top border. Rows divided by thin dotted lines.

persona_card.structure: Image (grayscale or high contrast) with corner brackets. Orange corner label tag (e.g., 'SCENE 01'). Title below with marker underline + short description.

service_clapper_card.structure: Kraft/Charcoal (#17120C) background, Clapperboard striped top bar, Anton font title, short description, numbered 'TAKE 01', 'TAKE 02' etc.

thumbnail_grid.description: Grid of vertical videos (Reels) with play buttons.
thumbnail_grid.structure: Tight grid (`gap-2` or `gap-4`). Images with a central circular play button (gold border, white fill, black triangle).

comparison_table.description: Before/After: Doing Everything Alone vs Doing What You're Best At.
comparison_table.structure: Two columns, tight rows. Left column (red/dim text), Right column (gold text, checkmarks). Arrow icon pointing from left to right in the middle.

cta_button.structure: Pill-shaped (`rounded-full`), `bg-[#F5B841] text-[#050505] font-['Anton'] uppercase text-xl px-8 py-3 hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-200 active:scale-95`.

layouts.flow: Tightly packed single-column flow. Content centered in a max-w-4xl or max-w-5xl container to look like a long printed poster.
layouts.spacing: Minimal large gaps. Use `py-12` or `py-16` max. Elements should feel dense and intentional.

sections.content: Grainy gold hero. 'TAKE 01', 'SCENE - INTRO'. Massive Anton headline. Info Slate card. CTA. Filmstrip border in black.
'REEL 02', 'SCENE - CASTING'. Grid of Persona Cards. Filmstrip border in gold/transparent.
'TAKE 01 - 13', 'SCENE - THE SETUP'. Grid of Service Clapper Cards.
'FEATURED REEL'. Thumbnail Grid with play buttons.
'LET'S ROLL' Tape tag. Lead form in a tight black slate card.

motion.guidance: Use `lenis` for smooth, heavy momentum scrolling to emulate reading a physical poster. Very subtle stagger entrance animations via Framer Motion, but NO large parallax or scroll gaps that break the dense layout.

persona_cards.description: Podcast microphone dark setup for 'Podcast Production' persona.
Video editing timeline screen for 'YouTube & Reels Editing' persona.
Film production crew for 'Commercial Video Production' persona.

accessibility.instructions: Ensure contrast between gold text and black background is above 4.5:1. All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` attributes. Form elements need explicit focus states (e.g., ring-gold).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT:
1. Build with React + Tailwind. 
2. STRICTLY NO generic centered layouts or modern SaaS glassmorphism. This is a VINTAGE POSTER. 
3. Elements must be tightly packed. Avoid huge `py-32` padding; keep padding tight and fill it with visual markers like tags, brackets, and slate text. 
4. Implement the film-strip side borders properly using CSS gradients or SVG repeating patterns to frame the whole site. 
5. Ensure Google Fonts (Anton, Manrope) are loaded in the head or index.css. 
6. For the form, keep it clean but styled like a production call sheet.
